title: Bossa Nova
tagline: Softly syncopated guitar, understated singing, and Brazilian songcraft.
summary: Bossa nova emerged in Brazil through a meeting of samba rhythms, modern songwriting, and jazz harmony. Its intimate vocals and syncopated guitar patterns created a quieter, more conversational feel than many dance-oriented styles. The music traveled internationally through recordings and collaborations, while remaining deeply connected to Brazilian composers and performers.

pillars.name: Joao Gilberto
pillars.why: Joao Gilberto's guitar rhythm and restrained vocal delivery became defining features of bossa nova.

pillars.name: Antonio Carlos Jobim
pillars.why: Antonio Carlos Jobim composed songs and harmonies that helped bring bossa nova to international listeners.

pillars.name: Vinicius de Moraes
pillars.why: Vinicius de Moraes contributed poetic lyrics and collaborations central to the early bossa nova repertoire.
